title: Process Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:
Responsible for driving the implementation of after-sales repair strategies, processes, and quality standards.
Review, pilot, validate, and implement new repair processes and technologies, ensuring SOPs are effectively rolled out across service centers and authorized partners.
Establish and improve repair quality systems to reduce repeat repairs and enhance service quality.
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex or hard-to-reproduce repair cases, drive continuous improvement, and build a local repair knowledge and case database.
Provide technical training and support to regional service teams and partners.

Qualifications & Requirements:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in EE, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in electronics hardware service, repair engineering, technical support, or repair operations. Experience with consumer electronics, mobile devices, smart hardware, or similar products is highly preferred.

Repair Process & Quality: Hands-on experience with repair processes, quality control, SOP development, process optimization, and repair quality improvement. Proven ability to identify process gaps and implement corrective actions to reduce repeat repair rates and improve first-time repair quality.

Technical Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate complex, intermittent, or difficult-to-reproduce hardware failures. Capable of leading root-cause analysis and developing practical solutions for challenging repair cases.

Strategy & Project Execution: Ability to translate HQ repair strategies into local processes and execution plans. Strong project management, validation, follow-up, and cross-functional coordination skills.

Knowledge Management: Experience documenting technical cases, solutions, troubleshooting methods, and lessons learned. Ability to establish and maintain a local repair knowledge base or case database.

Soft Skills: Strong ownership, attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to travel to service centers or partner locations when required.

Languages: Fluent in both English and Mandarin Chinese, with strong verbal and written communication skills for seamless collaboration with HQ and local/regional teams.

title: Key Account Support Specialist
description:
Key Account Support Specialist

The Key Account Support Specialist is responsible for providing technical and after-sales support to key customers, including distributors, dealers, and major retail accounts, ensuring that customer issues are addressed in a timely and efficient manner.

This role also supports spare parts ordering, shipment coordination, repair and replacement case tracking, as well as data collection and analysis, helping ensure smooth day-to-day operations and maintain strong customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Support – 20%

a. Provide technical support to key customers through phone calls, video meetings, and other communication channels.
b. Assist with product troubleshooting and basic fault diagnosis.
c. Record customer issues, track progress, and follow up to ensure issues are resolved within the required timeframe.

2. Retail Return & Exchange Support – 20%

a. Follow up on and coordinate return and exchange cases for major retail accounts in North America to ensure the process moves forward smoothly.
b. Track, summarize, and report abnormal or exceptional return and exchange cases, and promptly notify the Operations team for further follow-up.

3. Spare Parts & Order Support – 20%

a. Verify material information and inventory availability.
b. Prepare and process spare parts order request forms.
c. Follow up on payment status and shipment progress.
d. Coordinate with Warehouse and Logistics teams to help ensure timely delivery.

4. Repair & Replacement Case Follow-up – 15%

a. Track repair and replacement cases and ensure they are handled in accordance with applicable SLA requirements.
b. Maintain close communication with Technical Support and After-Sales Service teams to facilitate issue resolution and continuously improve customer satisfaction.

5. Failure Data Collection & Reporting – 10%

a. Collect, organize, and consolidate data related to product failures and service issues.
b. Conduct basic trend analysis and provide reports and insights to the regional FAE team.

6. Other Responsibilities – 15%

a. Perform other related duties assigned by the manager based on team and operational needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

1. Education
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.

2. Experience
3–5 years of experience in key account support, retail operations, customer service, sales operations, after-sales service, or a related function. Experience supporting major retail chains, distributors, or dealers is highly preferred.

3. Retail & Account Support
Strong understanding of retail customer needs and the ability to provide timely and effective support for service issues, orders, repairs, replacements, and other account-related requests.

4. Sales & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Proven ability to partner with Sales and coordinate effectively with Service, Logistics, Warehouse, Technical Support, and other cross-functional teams to resolve customer issues and meet account requirements.

5. Operations & Systems
Working knowledge of spare parts ordering, shipment coordination, repair tracking, and CRM/ERP systems. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic data analysis is required.

6. Communication & Problem-Solving
Strong communication, problem-solving, organizational, and follow-up skills, with a customer-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.

7. Languages
Professional fluency in English is required. Mandarin Chinese proficiency is preferred for communication and coordination with headquarters.

title: FAE
description:
Position Summary
As a FAE, you will serve as the primary technical and operational bridge between our HQ in China and the North American market. This role demands a unique blend of technical expertise, supply chain oversight, and partner management. You will be responsible for empowering our dealer network, auditing service quality, and ensuring that our localized SOPs are executed with precision across all third-party facilities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Warehouse & 3P Service Partner Management (30%)
• Service Partner Oversight: Act as the primary point of contact for third-party Service providers to monitor daily operations, spare parts inventory accuracy, and outbound lead times.
• KPI Management: Establish and track performance metrics for service partners (e.g., Turnaround Time (TAT), First Fix Rate (FFR), and inventory shrinkage).
• SOP Localization & Implementation: Translate and adapt global service standards into localized, actionable procedures for the North American market, ensuring full field adoption.
2. Service Network Audit & Field Operations (20%)
• Quarterly Field Audits: Conduct quarterly on-site visits to service partners and warehouses across various states for physical inventory reconciliation and asset counting.
• Quality Assurance (QA) Inspections: Perform rigorous service quality audits, including spot-checks of repair work orders, facility standards, and tool calibrations to ensure compliance with company SOPs.
• On-site Assistance: Provide hands-on support and residency at partner facilities, new product launches, or to resolve critical operational bottlenecks.
3. Technical Support & Partner Enablement (20%)
• Technical Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical guidance to North American dealers, distributors, Service Partners and internal teams regarding hardware failures, software bugs, and field applications.
• Training & Certification: Develop and deliver technical training programs for service partners to ensure their repair capabilities meet the brand’s global standards.
• Technical Documentation: Localize technical manuals, FAQs, and Technical Service Bulletins (TSB) to address region-specific product issues.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination (HQ Liaison) (20%)
• Global Feedback Loop: Synchronize with HQ R&D, Service Operations, and Customer Success teams to report field quality trends and advocate for product improvements.
• Reporting: Prepare comprehensive quarterly audit reports and performance reviews for executive leadership to guide partner contract renewals or terminations.
5. Ad-hoc Projects & Strategic Initiatives (10%)
• Emergency Response: Provide immediate on-site or remote support for critical product issues, safety recalls, or large-scale customer escalations as directed by HQ.
• New Product Launches (NPI): Assist in localized field testing, certification support, and technical demonstrations for new models (e.g., LUBA 3, YUKA series) during their North American debut.
• Market Expansion Support: Support the setting up of new self-operated service centers or the transition from third-party service providers to internal facilities.
• Trade Shows & Events: Provide technical expertise and product demonstrations at major industry trade shows and dealer events.

Qualifications & Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.
• Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Field Application Engineering or Technical Service Operations. Experience in the OPE (Outdoor Power Equipment), Robotics, or Smart Hardware industry is highly preferred.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in hardware diagnostics, log analysis, and utilizing CRM/ERP systems for service management.
• Operations Expertise: Proven ability to manage 3PL relationships and implement standardized quality control processes.
• Travel: Willingness to travel up to 25% (approximately once per quarter for 1-2 weeks at a time) across different US states.
• Languages: Native or professional fluency in English; professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required for seamless communication with HQ.
• Soft Skills: Strong negotiation skills for managing partner conflicts, meticulous attention to detail during audits, and the ability to work independently in a remote/field environment.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
- Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for overseeing existing and potential North America channel sales. The role will focus on leveraging sales expertise within the outdoor power equipment, especially Robotic Lawn Mower industry to enhance customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

Responsibilities
1. Development of local market distributors, dealers and retail channels, doing a good job of channel layout and maintaining good customer relationships.
2. Establish and manage new and existing relationships with customers including distributors, chain retailers, and independent dealers.
3. Responsible for the operation and management of the local market, preventing falsification and price disruption, and achieving performance targets.
4. Conduct intelligence collection and analysis of competing products in the local market, be familiar with the operation mode of the local market and industry and develop executable market development strategies and tactics.
5. Collaborate with all relevant departments to carry out local front-end market insights and provide a basis for back-end decisions.
6. New product introduction to every key account, from early phase communication to launch, in accordance with their assortment selection process.

Qualifications
1. 5-10 years of experience in channel sales in outdoor power equipment or outdoor living category or related industries.
2. With connections with equipment dealers and big box retailers is a plus.
3. Experience of working for international companies is a plus.
4. Experience of handling complex supplier agreements and managing relationships with retailers.
5. Experience in new market breakthroughs and new business development.

title: field test engineer
description:
• Conduct hands-on field testing of robotic pool cleaners and robotic lawn mowers in real-world environments.
• Coordinate with beta testers, guide them through setup and usage, collect structured feedback, and document usability issues.
• Serve as the primary liaison between testers and the internal engineering team, ensuring timely escalation and clear communication of issues.
• Diagnose and report firmware bugs, hardware issues, and design flaws based on testing and user reports.
• Assist in reproducing and isolating bugs; work closely with firmware engineers on logs, edge case behaviors, and performance tracking.
• Track test metrics and maintain organized logs for issue tracking, feedback trends, and user experience summaries.
• Provide actionable feedback to improve product usability, durability, and overall customer satisfaction.

• 2+ years of experience in hardware field testing, QA, beta program coordination, or consumer electronics testing.
• Hands-on knowledge of robotic products, such as robotic pool cleaners, robotic mowers, vacuum robots, or smart home devices.
• Comfortable identifying technical issues related to firmware behavior, sensors, connectivity, and mechanical performance.
• Strong communicator able to work between technical and non-technical audiences.
• Organized, methodical, and confident working in semi-structured, fast-paced startup environments.
• Willing to travel to testing sites or customer homes occasionally if needed (travel expenses covered).
Preferred Qualifications:
• Prior experience working on robotic consumer devices or customer electronics
• Familiarity with log file review, firmware update workflows, or bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence)
• Experience working with beta testing communities or managing user feedback loops
• Basic understanding of embedded systems or mechatronics (a plus, not required)

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Key Account Manager – Retail (U.S. Market)

Location: Remote in USA
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Key Account Manager to manage and grow our retail business in the U.S. market. This role will be responsible for retailer onboarding, commercial negotiations, contract management, and day-to-day account operations with major U.S. retailers.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with big-box retailers and understands how to navigate retail systems, commercial terms, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced consumer product environment.

Key Responsibilities

Out-reach to new retailers to establish new accounts.

Retail Account Development & Onboarding

Lead retailer onboarding processes with major U.S. retailers such as Home Depot, Lowe’s, Costco, Best Buy, and similar accounts

Coordinate internal teams to complete retailer setup, including item onboarding, system configuration, and compliance documentation

Manage retailer-specific requirements, guidelines, and operational standards

Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management

Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, margin structure, promotional funding, rebates, chargebacks, and payment terms

Review, negotiate, and manage retailer contracts and annual agreements

Work closely with legal and finance teams to ensure contract compliance and risk control

Order Management & Account Operations

Oversee purchase order (PO) management, order forecasting, and fulfillment coordination

Monitor order flow, delivery schedules, and inventory status to ensure on-time execution

Manage retailer portals and systems (e.g., Retail Link, Lowe’s systems, Costco vendor portals)

Account Performance & Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts

Build strong working relationships with retail buyers, planners, and merchandising teams

Track account performance, sales trends, and key KPIs

Identify growth opportunities including assortment expansion, new product launches, and promotional programs

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with supply chain, operations, after-sales, marketing, and finance teams to support account execution

Coordinate retail returns, chargebacks, deductions, and operational issues

Support new product launches and seasonal planning

Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing U.S. retail key accounts

Proven experience working with major U.S. retailers (Home Depot, Lowe’s, Costco, Best Buy, Walmart, or similar)

Strong understanding of retail commercial terms, contract structures, and negotiation processes

Experience in outdoor equipment, lawn & garden, power tools, robotics, or consumer electronics (3C) strongly preferred

Familiar with retailer systems, PO processes, and retail compliance requirements

Strong communication and negotiation skills

Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
岗位职责：
1. 第三方海外仓现场管理
- 实地监督第三方海外仓日常运营，确保各出入库流程严格符合 SOP 标准；
- 持续监控核心 KPI 指标，推动服务商持续改进；
- 定期组织库存盘点，确保账物一致；
- 持续优化仓库作业流程，提高效率与准确率。
2. 订单交付保障
- 重点负责 2B 订单交付管理，确保处理优先级与交付稳定性；
- 协调尾程运输资源（LTL/FTL），对接承运商并保障运输时效；
- 全流程跟踪订单履约情况，及时向国内团队及客户反馈物流进展。
3. 异常处理与风险管控
- 快速响应运输延误、货损、丢失等异常，制定并推动应急解决方案；
- 协调海外仓、承运商与客户三方，处理退换货等问题；
- 识别爆仓、运力紧张、政策变动等供应链潜在风险，提前预警并制定预案。
4. 跨部门协作与关系维护
- 作为物流团队的现场代表，承接国内需求并反馈仓库实际运营情况；
- 建立并维护与第三方仓及物流服务商的良好合作关系；
- 协助销售团队参与客户会议，提供专业物流解决方案支持。

1. 本科及以上学历，2 年及以上美国本土跨境电商物流或海外仓运营经验；
2. 熟悉美国仓储与配送市场，了解 FBA、第三方海外仓及尾程配送模式；
3. 熟悉美国 LTL/FTL 运输市场，拥有优质承运商资源者优先；具备 Walmart、Target、Best Buy 等主流商超供应链服务经验者优先；
4. 熟悉美国物流法规、进出口清关流程及商超收货标准。

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
1. On-Site Technical Support & Troubleshooting / 现场技术支持与故障诊断 Responsible for on-site installation, base station/boundary deployment guidance, mapping setup, and troubleshooting for robotic lawn mowers and smart garden tools in Japan, South Korea, and Thailand. Promptly respond to and resolve technical post-sales and field usage issues for local distributors and dealers.
负责日韩泰区域内智能割草机器人及庭院工具的现场安装、基站/边界部署指导、地图建立引导与故障排查。快速响应并解决当地代理商/经销商的技术售后与现场使用问题。

2. Technical Training for Channel & After-Sales Teams / 渠道与售后团队技术培训 Conduct regular technical training on product features, operation, app connectivity, common fault diagnostics, and maintenance for distributors, dealers, and after-sales service centers across Japan, South Korea, and Thailand to establish local service standards. Coordinate with HQ on distributor KPI evaluations. 针对日韩泰三地的代理商、经销商及售后服务网点，定期开展产品功能、操作使用、APP 连接、常见故障诊断与维修保养的技术培训，建立当地服务规范。配合总部对代理商的 KPI 考核。

3. Scenario Validation & On-Site Testing / 场景验证与测试落地 Perform on-site mapping validation and product adaptability testing tailored to unique lawn environments in Japan, South Korea, and Thailand (e.g., narrow lawns, complex terrain, steep slopes). 针对日本、韩国及泰国特有的庭院环境（如狭长草坪、复杂地形、多坡度等场景），配合进行现场建图验证与产品适配性测试。

4. Information Collection & Data Feedback / 信息收集与数据反馈 Collect field machine operation logs, environmental anomaly data, and hardware/software fault info. Seamlessly interface with HQ FAE/R&D teams to ensure issue closure and drive product iterations. 收集一线机器运行日志（Log）、环境异常数据及软硬件故障信息，与总部 FAE / 研发团队无障碍对接，跟进问题闭环并驱动产品迭代。

5. Technical Support for Sales & Trade Shows / 技术护航与市场展会支持 Collaborate with local sales and DIY channel teams to provide technical demonstrations, new product trial promotions, and technical support at offline trade shows and exhibitions. 配合当地销售与 DIY 渠道团队进行前期技术演示、新品试用推广及线下展会的技术保障。

1. Educational Background / 专业背景
● Bachelor’s degree or above in Electronic Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Robotics Engineering, Telecommunications, or related fields. 电子工程、自动化、机电一体化、机器人工程、通信工程等相关专业本科及以上学历。

2. Experience Requirements / 经验要求
● 1+ years of experience in FAE, technical support, or on-site after-sales service.
● Experience in robotic lawn mowers, smart home appliances/service robots, outdoor smart hardware, or DIY power tools is preferred.
● 1 年以上 FAE、技术支持或现场售后服务经验；有割草机器人、智能家电/服务型机器人、户外智能硬件或 DIY 动力工具行业经验者优先。

3. Professional Skills / 专业技能要求
● Hardware & Hands-On Skills: Familiar with electromechanical structures and circuit fundamentals; hands-on capability in circuit board testing, wiring troubleshooting, and component assembly/disassembly/replacement.
● 硬件与动手能力: 熟悉机电结构与电路基础，具备电路板检测、线束排查及零部件拆装/更换的实际动手能力。
● Software & App Debugging: Proficient in using debugging tools and end-user apps; able to guide customers and distributors through system connection, OTA firmware updates, and parameter tuning.
● 软件/APP 调试与操作: 熟练掌握相关产品调试工具与用户端 APP，能指导客户与代理商完成系统连接、固件升级（OTA）及参数调优。
● Troubleshooting & Log Collection: Logical troubleshooting mindset; capable of guiding on-site system log retrieval and compiling standardized fault reports for HQ.
● 故障定位与日志收集: 具备清晰的故障排查思路，能够指导现场抓取系统日志（Log）并整理规范的故障报告提交给总部。

4. Language Proficiency / 语言能力
● Japanese: Business fluent or native (ability to communicate seamlessly with local clients and partners). 日语: 商务流利及以上（能够无障碍与日韩泰当地客户及合作伙伴沟通）。
● English/Chinese: Business fluent; ability to communicate seamlessly with HQ R&D and FAE teams. 英语或中文: 商务流利，能够无障碍与总部（Headquarters）研发及 FAE 团队对接沟通。
● Bonus: Ability to communicate in Korean is a plus. / 能够用韩语进行交流为加分项。

5. Soft Skills & Travel / 综合素质与出差
● Excellent on-site communication skills, independent problem-solving ability, and a strong service mindset. Ability to undertake short-term international travel within Japan, South Korea, and Thailand.
● 具备优秀的现场沟通能力、独立解决问题能力及很强的服务意识；能够适应日韩泰区域内的短期跨国出差。

title: 仓库管理员
description:
1.出入库与库存管理
负责到货验收、上架、拣货、打包及发货等日常出入库操作
使用仓库管理系统（WMS）或 Office 软件登记出入库记录，保证账实一致和出库及时性、准确性
定期开展库存盘点，核对并报告库存差异，跟踪损耗原因
维护仓库整洁与安全，合理规划库位、优化货物存放

2.叉车操作
驾驶叉车完成货物装卸、搬运与堆垛作业
按规定执行叉车日常检查与基础保养，发现故障及时上报

3.翻新机维修与售后协助
协助技术人员完成翻新设备的拆装、搬运、测试与入库
配合处理客户退换货、返修及售后备件的收发与登记
记录返修设备的处理进度，跟进售后流程直至闭环

1. 持有澳大利亚有效的叉车操作许可证（High Risk Work Licence，LF 类），能够熟练驾驶叉车
2. 1 年以上仓库或物流相关工作经验，有库存管理经验者优先
3. 具备基础的翻新、维修协助经验，或愿意学习相关操作
4. 熟悉电脑操作，能使用 WMS 或 Office 软件进行库存登记
5. 具备在澳大利亚合法工作的权利
6. 责任心强、做事细致，安全意识良好，具备团队协作能力

7. 加分项：
7.1 有电子设备、家电或机械设备翻新 / 维修经验
7.2 英语沟通能力良好，能与本地供应商及客户顺畅对接

title: Account Manager
description:
**Key responsibilities**
1. Retail account management*
• Manage the day-to-day relationship with assigned national retail accounts and maintain regular, professional communication with buyers, category teams, retail operations teams and store stakeholders.
• Build trusted working relationships across retailer head offices and store networks, ensuring requests, actions and issues are followed through to completion.
• Prepare for and participate in regular account meetings, sales reviews, planning sessions and operational discussions.
• Maintain clear account plans, meeting notes, action registers and customer records within the company's CRM and reporting systems.
• Identify account growth opportunities and provide recommendations to the Sales Director for strategic or commercial consideration.
2. Orders, stock and forecasting*
• Coordinate purchase orders, product availability, delivery timing and retailer requirements with supply chain, logistics, finance and customer service teams.
• Monitor open orders, backorders and delivery performance, escalating risks early and communicating accurate updates to customers.
• Support demand forecasting by gathering retailer forecasts, promotional expectations, sales trends and store-level feedback.
• Monitor sell-in, sell-through, stock-on-hand, weeks of cover and product performance, highlighting risks and opportunities.
• Assist with EDI, retailer portals, new-line forms, product data, item setup and other account administration.
3. Product launches, promotions and retail execution
• Coordinate new product launches and ranging implementation across online and physical retail channels.
• Work with retailers and internal marketing teams to deliver agreed promotional plans, campaigns, product content and launch activities.
• Coordinate display stock, demonstration units, point-of-sale materials, merchandising requirements and store communications.
• Conduct store visits to review product presentation, stock availability, staff knowledge, competitor activity and execution standards.
• Support retail events, trade shows, demonstrations and seasonal sales activities as required.
4. Training and product support
• Deliver engaging product and sales training for retailer head-office teams, state teams and store staff.
• Help retail staff understand product selection, key technology, installation, customer qualification, warranty processes and common customer questions.
• Coordinate training schedules, venues, demonstration equipment and supporting materials with retailer and internal stakeholders.
• Gather retailer and customer feedback and share practical insights with sales, product, marketing and after-sales teams.
5. Issue resolution and internal coordination*
• Act as the central coordinator for day-to-day account issues involving orders, freight, invoices, claims, displays, product information and after-sales support.
• Work collaboratively with sales, marketing, operations, finance, logistics, technical support and service partners to resolve issues promptly.
• Maintain ownership of open actions and provide customers with clear progress updates until resolution.
• Prepare weekly and monthly account reports covering sales, orders, stock, forecasts, promotions, risks, opportunities and agreed actions.
• Track performance against account targets and agreed launch or promotional objectives.
• Support the preparation of range reviews, business reviews, promotional proposals, pricing files and retailer presentations.
• Ensure approved pricing, promotional funding and commercial arrangements are implemented accurately; refer negotiations or material changes to the Sales Director.

*Experience and qualifications*
• At least two years' experience in account management, retail sales, supplier management or a related commercial role.
• Experience working with Bunnings, Harvey Norman, JB Hi-Fi or another large Australian national retail chain is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated experience managing retailer relationships, orders, promotions, product launches and operational follow-through.
• Experience in consumer electronics, power garden, outdoor living, home improvement, appliances, hardware, technology or another relevant consumer-product category is preferred.
• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and CRM or account-management systems.
• A relevant business, sales or marketing qualification is desirable but not essential.
• Current Australian driver's licence and the ability to travel regularly.
• Full working rights in Australia.
*Skills and personal attributes*
• Strong relationship-building and can do attitude, with the confidence to communicate with buyers, store teams and internal leaders.
• Highly organised, responsive and able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders.

title: Service Partner Management
description:
Position Overview
The Channel Partner Management role is responsible for managing after-sales service operations and overall service performance of channel partners across the assigned European region.
This position serves as a key business interface between the company and its distributors, dealers, and other channel partners, ensuring effective implementation of company service policies, processes, and standards.
The role continuously manages partner capabilities, operational performance, service data, and key service issues, while working closely with Technical Support, Spare Parts, Logistics, Quality, Sales, and global service teams to improve partner service quality and end-customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
1. Channel Partner Management
Manage daily after-sales operations of distributors, dealers, and channel partners within the assigned region, maintain strong business relationships, and ensure effective execution of company service policies and requirements.
2. After-sales Operations Management
Coordinate and support daily after-sales activities, including repair, warranty, returns, replacements, DOA, RMA, spare parts, and logistics.
3. Warranty and RMA Management
Review and follow up on warranty, RMA, DOA, return, and replacement requests from channel partners, ensuring compliance with company policies, processes, and authorization requirements.
4. Partner Capability Development
Support and develop channel partners' local after-sales capabilities, including service processes, repair capabilities, technical training, system usage, and standardized operations.
5. Service Performance Management
Monitor key service KPIs, including turnaround time, repair quality, repeat repair rate, warranty cost, spare parts consumption, and customer satisfaction, and drive continuous improvement.
6. Escalation and Major Issue Management
Coordinate major after-sales issues, customer complaints, and escalated cases within the region. Work with relevant internal teams to identify root causes, develop solutions, and ensure timely closure.
7. Spare Parts and Service Cost Management
Coordinate channel partner spare parts requirements and inventory status, review after-sales related costs including spare parts, labor, and logistics, and support effective service cost control.
8. Operational Data Analysis
Regularly collect and analyze channel partner service data, identify operational issues and risks, and drive improvement actions based on data and performance results.
9. Service Policy and Process Implementation
Drive implementation of new service policies, service standards, repair processes, and system requirements across channel partners and monitor execution quality.
10. Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Quality, Spare Parts, Logistics, Service Operations, and global teams to ensure timely resolution of channel partner issues.
11. Market and Partner Feedback
Collect and consolidate feedback from channel partners and end customers regarding products, service experience, and operational processes, and provide structured feedback to Product, Quality, and global teams.

1. Education
Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, or a related field.
2. Experience
Relevant experience in channel management, after-sales service, customer service, or regional operations. Experience in robotics, smart hardware, automotive, machinery, outdoor power equipment, or consumer electronics is preferred.
3. Channel Management Skills
Experience managing distributors, dealers, or channel partners, with the ability to independently handle daily partner operations and complex business issues.
4. After-sales Service Knowledge
Good understanding of warranty, RMA, DOA, repair, spare parts, logistics, and after-sales service processes.
5. Problem-solving Skills
Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to independently manage customer complaints and major escalations.
6. Data and Cost Awareness
Strong data awareness and cost management mindset, with the ability to identify issues and drive improvements based on operational data and service KPIs.
7. Language Requirements
Professional working proficiency in one of the following combinations:
- German + English
- French + English
8. The candidate should be able to communicate effectively with European channel partners in daily business operations.
9. Systems and Office Skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office. Experience with CRM, ERP, ticketing systems, or other after-sales service management systems is preferred.
10. Other Requirements
Strong ownership, service mindset, and teamwork skills. Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and willing to travel within Europe when required.
